title: Foundation First Reproduction — Earliest Recovered Living-Lineage Evidence
purpose: Separate founding from reproduction by recording the earliest recovered evidence that a Foundation survived beyond its Door through consolidation, branching, refoundation, successor operation or another reproducible lineage signal.
master_rule: A founding event is not itself proof of reproduction. Treat the earliest recovered post-Door event as a current evidence boundary, not automatically the historically first reproduction.

evidence_states.dated branching: A dated branch/successor event is present in the canonical record.
evidence_states.dated consolidation/refoundation: A dated post-Door consolidation or refoundation event demonstrates continuity beyond the initial crossing, though a still-earlier successor may exist.
evidence_states.undated structural reproduction: Branches/descendants exist in the canonical genealogy but the first dated reproduction event is not yet recovered.
evidence_states.reproduction mechanism only: The mechanism is defined, but no separate post-Door lineage event has yet been recovered.
